shortDescription: Manage a namespace in a Rancher downstream cluster

options.name: is_system
options.description: Whether the namespace should be identified as a system namespace in the Rancher UI

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Kubernetes C(Namespace) object.

options.name: project
options.description: points to The Kubernetes `Project` object in the upstream Rancher, that this namespace should belong to.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired postcondition, either V(present) or V(absent). Note that deleting a project (with V(absent)) wont't delete the namespaces and resources that formerly belonged to the project.
